itineraries.title: Five days on the Costa Blanca
itineraries.intro: Valencia, the Marina Alta capes and the Columbretes.

days.note: Board in the marina; the City of Arts and Sciences.
The castle over the town and the Montgó headland; a swim at Les Rotes.
Cap de la Nau and the coves.
The Penyal d’Ifac rock above the harbour; the salt lagoon behind the beach.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Valencia to Alicante
itineraries.intro: The Valencian coast south, with a day at the Columbretes.

days.note: The City of Arts and Sciences and the old market; board at the marina.
The volcanic islets of the marine reserve, forty miles offshore.
The castle over the town and the Montgó headland; a swim at Les Rotes.
The bay under Cap de la Nau and the coves along the cape.
The Penyal d’Ifac rock above the harbour; the salt lagoon behind the beach.
The walled island off Alicante and its marine reserve for the afternoon swim.
The Santa Bárbara castle over the bay; disembark at the marina.
